Title: Document 1
Content: Source: Julian Grenfell, junior officer, letter to his mother from the Western Front, `text(November 3, 1914)`.

I have not washed for a `text(week)`, or had my boots off for a `text(fortnight)`... It is all the best fun. I have never, never felt so well, or so happy, or enjoyed anything so much. It just suits my stolid health, and stolid nerves, and barbaric disposition. The fighting excitement vitalizes everything, every sight and word and action. `text(One)` loves `text(one's)` fellow man so much more when `text(one)` is bent on killing him. And picnicking in the open `text(day)` and night (we never see a roof now) is the real method of existence.
